Use "keep_selected", "discard_selected", or "uncertain" for each feedback. If a final object cannot be determined from the observations, use "uncertain".

Policy 1: first select ace of diamonds, ace of spades; then select the first object in the order of the two remaining objects.
Policy 2: first select ace of diamonds, ace of spades; then select the last object in the order of the two remaining objects.
Policy 3: first select ace of clubs, ace of hearts; then select the first object in the order of the two remaining objects.
Policy 4: first select ace of clubs, ace of hearts; then select the last object in the order of the two remaining objects.

Return only JSON with "policy_1", "policy_2", "policy_3", and "policy_4"; each contains "first_feedback", "second_feedback", and "final".
